reviews.title: An EXCELLENT and VERY capable SSD for the price!
reviews.comment: I bought this SSD intending to use it as the primary C: drive for a new desktop PC I built personally for my daily business and gaming use. For the price I paid I couldn't be more pleased. My OS(Windows 11) and 2 very large and pretty demanding MMORPGs are installed on this drive and it hasn't failed to keep up with my demands or perform any task I've asked of it in the last few months. It's even out-performed my high end GPU a couple of times when things got incredibly demanding while gaming. I monitor my PC and all it's components in real time at least once weekly and run monthly diagnostics on everything as well and this little 500GB SSD is performing extremely well while maintaining a cool and stable temperature that leads me to believe it will have a very acceptable lifespan. I'm particularly pleased with the load speeds while gaming and the read/write speeds and capabilities it's provided WHILE running 4-5 programs at once on multiple monitors. Compatible with Windows 10 and 11(and much more), it  runs smoothly with no necessary manufacturer driver downloads or anything at all other than a basic install into a standard M.2 port. I'll be buying these KingSpecs for as long as they're for sale, whenever I'm in need of a quality SSD. VERY pleased with this product.
reviews.author: Stonizona

reviews.title: Decent Budget NVMe
reviews.comment: It's a 1TB Gen3 NVMe at a fair price given the memory market. It's certainly not the fastest drive out there, but it works fine for general use/gaming. I wouldn't put this in a top-tier PC, but if you want a decent amount of storage it's not a bad buy. I've purchased some other KingSpec NVMe's before and never had an issue so I expect the same from this. If you are doing anything drive intensive you will certainly want to invest in something better, though.
reviews.author: Paul
